items.text: SEASON 7 · EPISODE 11 · BOSS LEVEL · DRAFT  Estate-scale operations and lifecycle problem · Level 3  Corvane Group: one all-hands streamed live to forty sites in three countries. Firmware drift, a 50 Hz site with 60 Hz kit, and an integrator with a shared password. Henrik wants it perfect.  ⚑ CH-01 · BOSS-01: five physics challenges, a signal trace and the calls that aren't yours to make — on the clock. Fail anything and the run starts over. The edge of the screen glows yellow under pressure, red when time is short or the run fails, green when you clear it; it pulses no faster than once a second, and holds steady if you prefer reduced motion.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Under pressure, the method doesn't change: trace the signal from source to destination, fix one thing at a time and prove it where the people are, and hand every decision that isn't yours to the person who owns it — the electrician, the rigger and structural engineer, the network owner, security, the emergency managers, the clinical and privacy owners, the artist. Then write it down.
